Full suite description (not the scope of this run):
Frozen oracle v1 + music + imported intro + OI text/title + PNG: 17 exports + 60 checker controls; not full feature coverage.
Text: bounded OI topology, not general OCR; OEM fonts may fail fixed bounds. Title: one silent normal 48sp OI/black configuration, then original video/audio. PNG: fixed transparent 64×32 image, 20% width, X/Y 75%; analytic alpha/geometry checks.
SKIP: other titles and text/intro/music combinations. UI interactions, pickers, preview, copy/share, lifecycle and accessibility are NOT exercised by the suite.
Uses the fixed shipped standard.mp4 and analytic references, never user media.
